justification.text: `log (log n)` is Robin's log log n and never a junk value here, because the statement is under the hypothesis `n > 5040`, so log n > log 5040 > 8 > 1 and hence log log n > 0; the argument of the outer logarithm is positive throughout the stated range.

`n > 5040` is Robin's criterion's own range (strict), because the registry's `robin_criterion` (upstream RiemannHypothesisEquivalents.lean line 47) states RH ↔ `∀ n > 5040, σ n < e^γ n log log n`, and n = 5040 itself violates the inequality, which is why the criterion starts strictly above it.
